title: Add DLQ/Error summary widget to Command Center
description:
The HomePage (Command Center) is missing a DLQ/error summary section. Add a compact widget showing: recent DLQ entries count, top failure reasons, and a "View DLQ" link.

**Implementation:**
- Create `dashboard/src/components/home/DLQSummary.tsx`
- Use `useDLQ()` hook from `hooks/useDLQ.ts` to fetch recent entries
- Display: total count, last 3 failure reasons (truncated), link to `/dlq`
- Match existing Card + compact layout pattern from other home components
- Add to HomePage grid below the existing sections

**Files:** `dashboard/src/components/home/DLQSummary.tsx` (new), `dashboard/src/pages/HomePage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: DLQ summary widget renders on Command Center
